nodes.title: READ FIRST · Setup
widgets_values:
# UltraTex Modular • FLUX.2 Klein **BASE 9B** GGUF

1. Select your **GLB** in Load 3D. Must be one static mesh with non-overlapping UVs.
2. Select reference IMAGE and MASK (LoadImage MASK = background).
3. Choose the **BASE** Klein 9B GGUF, Qwen3-8B, FLUX2 VAE, both released UltraTex LoRAs and flux2 decoder.
4. Queue. Job index 0 = albedo, 1 = metallic/roughness. Saves final GLB + three texture PNGs.

**8GB starting preset:** 512 views + 2048 atlas. Increase only after measured VRAM success.
**Warning:** Input/model filenames are placeholders. Uses native Get 3D Components to accept the loader FILE_3D socket. Workflow wiring checked statically; no live ComfyUI/GPU execution performed.
